hints.title: Full Binary Tree Parity Constraint
hints.text: A full binary tree must possess an odd number of total nodes because each non-leaf node adds two children.

hints.title: Subtree Size Partitioning
hints.text: Distribute the remaining n - 1 nodes between left and right subtrees across all odd sizes i and n - 1 - i.

hints.title: Cartesian Product Assembly with Memoization
hints.text: For each valid left and right subproblem tree list, pair each left tree with each right tree under a new root. Cache results by node count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Catalan number growth of valid full binary tree topologies.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subtrees without caching duplicates subtree generations exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization table caches tree node lists by integer count N.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Even N returns empty list; odd N combines Cartesian pairs of subproblems.
